need_sha() { [ "$(sha "$1")" = "$2" ] || { echo "digest mismatch for $1 (candidate expects $2)" >&2; exit 1; }; }
need_ver() { case "$1" in *"$VER"*) ;; *) echo "version output '"'"'$1'"'"' lacks $VER" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; }
export HOME="$D/home"; mkdir -p "$HOME"
curl -fsSL "${B1_INSTALL_SH_URL:-https://agent-assembly.com/install.sh}" -o "$D/install.sh"
AASM_NO_MODIFY_PATH=1 sh "$D/install.sh" --profile full --version "$TAG" --install-dir "$D/bin"
need_ver "$("$D/bin/aa-gateway" --version)"
need_sha "$D/bin/aa-gateway" a0a25523655c1629d0da940cf0417453c8ad75e9be3ed2d48e0f26e55b7d1619
curl -fsSL "${B1_POLICY_URL:-https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ai-agent-assembly/agent-assembly/$TAG/policy-examples/low-risk.yaml}" -o "$D/low-risk.yaml"
need_sha "$D/low-risk.yaml" 61e40c48e806e353e6810c29152b6c54efeb9127eb068d9698b3b150193e4858
P="$(python3 -I -c '"'"'import socket;s=socket.socket();s.bind(("127.0.0.1",0));print(s.getsockname()[1])'"'"')"
"$D/bin/aa-gateway" --policy "$D/low-risk.yaml" --listen "127.0.0.1:$P" --audit-dir "$D/audit" --db-path "$D/gw.db" >"$D/gw.log" 2>&1 &
G=$!
trap '"'"'kill "$G" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf "$D"'"'"' EXIT
i=0

  sleep 0.5
